stories.h: Calls reportedly grow for Atiku to drop his 2027 presidential ambition
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar, the ADC's 2027 presidential candidate, is reportedly facing fresh calls to withdraw from the race. The report says a new reason has emerged behind the demand, though the details are still being discussed.
more: The call comes as parties step up their 2027 campaigns
Atiku earlier criticised President Tinubu over his remarks on hunger
stories.credit: Photo: Atiku Abubakar / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Video of Davido and Zlatan pleading with the bride's parents at the wedding stirs online buzz
stories.p: A clip from Zlatan Ibile and Davita's wedding reportedly shows Davido joining the groom to plead with the bride's parents during the traditional ceremony. The video has drawn wide reaction online, with many fans praising the friendship.
more: Davido arrived at the venue in a white Rolls-Royce
Several celebrities were photographed among the guests
stories.alt: Davido performing on stage in Lagos
stories.credit: Photo: Kaizenify / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Met Police reportedly forwards a letter about Meghan's father to the Sussexes' office
stories.p: London's Metropolitan Police has reportedly passed on a letter containing allegations about Thomas Markle Sr. to the office of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex. The contents of the letter have not been made public.
more: The report says the force acted as a forwarding step
Neither side has publicly commented in detail
stories.credit: Photo: Northern Ireland Office / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: VeryDarkMan calls for a probe into how singer B-Red got his car
stories.p: Social media critic VeryDarkMan has reportedly asked the authorities to look into how singer B-Red acquired his car, saying the means was not clean. B-Red has not been reported to have responded, and no agency has confirmed any inquiry.
more: The claim is said to have been made in a fresh online post.
It follows VeryDarkMan's other recent public call-outs of entertainers.

stories.h: Gospel singer Tope Alabi warns social media users against defamation
stories.p: Gospel singer Tope Alabi has reportedly warned online users against spreading false claims about her and said she is ready to take legal action. The warning is said to have followed fresh rumours about her circulating on social media.
more: She is said to have urged people to verify claims before posting.
No suit has been reported filed yet.

stories.h: Rita Edochie says she is not against polygamy, clarifying her stance
stories.p: Nollywood actress Rita Edochie has reportedly said she is not against polygamy and that people have misread her position. She is said to have spoken after fans reacted to her earlier comments.
more: Her earlier remarks had sparked debate online.
She is said to have called for respect on both sides of the argument.

stories.h: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case in Abuja as health officials trace 44 contacts
stories.p: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control says a woman who arrived from Uganda has tested positive for Ebola in Abuja, the country's first case in about a decade. Health Minister Muhammad Pate says 44 contacts, including health workers and caregivers, are being traced. A toll-free line, 6232, has been opened for suspected cases, while some Nigerians question how long detection took.
more: Symptoms reportedly began on 7 October and she was admitted to a private hospital on 11 October.
The US embassy has also advised Americans in Nigeria on precautions.
Kenya has also recorded cases in the same regional outbreak.
stories.alt: A health worker in a protective suit
stories.credit: Stock image: DFID / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Phyna reportedly invited by police over a rented wig controversy
stories.p: Former Big Brother Naija winner Phyna has reportedly been invited by the police after a dispute over a rented wig. A separate video also shows an officer telling her he did not recognise her as a celebrity during a routine check. Neither matter has been fully explained publicly.
more: The wig dispute reportedly started online before police stepped in.
Fans are split between mocking the exchange and defending her.

stories.h: MultiChoice reportedly confirms cheaper DStv decoders and subscription prices
stories.p: MultiChoice has reportedly taken a final decision to reduce the prices of DStv decoders and subscription packages in Nigeria. The company is said to have not yet published every new price, so customers are advised to check before renewing.
more: The cut is said to follow months of complaints about subscription costs.
Full package-by-package prices are still awaited.
stories.credit: Stock image: osde8info / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Marketers reportedly announce new diesel prices after Dangote halts gantry sales
stories.p: Fuel marketers have reportedly released new pump prices after the Dangote Refinery stopped selling diesel at its gantry. It is not yet clear how long the pause will last or how much it will affect supply.
more: Marketers say they are adjusting to the change in supply arrangements.
The reported rise in output at the Edo refinery may ease pressure on diesel.
stories.credit: Stock image: Nan Palmero / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Dutch-born Serie A star reportedly agrees to play for the Super Eagles
stories.p: A Netherlands-born player in Italy's Serie A has reportedly agreed to represent Nigeria at senior level. The Nigeria Football Federation has not yet confirmed the switch or the player's eligibility paperwork.
more: Nigeria has been widening its search for dual-nationality players.
A formal announcement is awaited.
stories.alt: A football match in a packed stadium
stories.credit: Stock image: nova3web / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Turkish pundit questions Osimhen's man-of-the-match award in Galatasaray win over Lille
stories.p: A Turkish football commentator has questioned why Victor Osimhen was named player of the match after Galatasaray beat Lille in the Champions League. The debate has divided fans, with many Nigerians defending the striker.
more: Galatasaray took the win in Europe's top club competition.
Osimhen has not responded to the comments.

stories.h: Gombe Assembly reportedly approves the creation of a state police force
stories.p: Lawmakers in Gombe State have reportedly voted to back the creation of a state police force. The move follows wider national debate on decentralising policing amid insecurity concerns.
more: Several state assemblies have been weighing similar backing.
Federal approval would still be needed for any change.
stories.credit: Stock image: theglobalpanorama / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Antonio Conte reportedly in contact with Manchester United over the manager job
stories.p: Reports say Manchester United have made initial contact over Antonio Conte as a possible replacement for Michael Carrick. Conte is said to be ready to start immediately, though the club has not confirmed any talks. Other names, including Eddie Howe, have also been linked.
more: Carrick is reportedly still backed by the board for now.
Another poor result could change the picture, according to the reports.
stories.credit: Photo: Nicola Genati / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Soludo says backing Tinubu in 2027 could pave the way for an Igbo presidency
stories.p: Anambra governor Charles Soludo has argued that South-East support for President Tinubu's second term could open the door to an Igbo president later. He has said his party, APGA, will not field a presidential candidate. Supporters of other candidates, including Peter Obi, have not accepted that argument.
more: Soludo has urged Igbo voters not to call votes for other candidates wasted.
The stance has drawn mixed reactions in the South-East.

stories.h: Businesswoman Jaruma reportedly in police custody over social media posts
stories.p: Jaruma has reportedly been held by police since Monday over posts she made online. She is said to face strict bail conditions. Police have not given a full public account.
more: Her supporters are asking for clarity on the charges.
No court date has been publicly reported.

stories.h: DJ DSF sparks debate by saying people who cannot afford children should not have them
stories.p: The media personality reportedly said that people who are struggling financially should hold off on having children. His remark drew a mix of agreement and criticism online.
more: Many commenters pointed to the rising cost of living.
Others said parenthood should not be judged by income.

stories.h: Two of Tinubu's ministerial nominees were reportedly turned down by a group close to Buhari
stories.p: A report says two people President Tinubu once considered for ministerial posts were rejected by a circle linked to former President Buhari. The claim has not been confirmed by the Presidency. A former presidential aide has separately offered his explanation for why Fasola is not in the cabinet.
more: The report was circulating widely on political blogs on Sunday.
The Presidency has not publicly responded to the claim.

stories.h: Viral prediction cat tips the winner of Barcelona v Real Madrid El Clasico
stories.p: A cat that has gained a following for football forecasts has made its pick for the El Clasico between Barcelona and Real Madrid. Fans online are sharing the video ahead of kick-off.
more: The cat's earlier predictions have been widely shared on social media.
The match is one of La Liga's biggest fixtures of the season.

stories.h: Supercomputer now tips Arsenal for the Premier League title after Manchester City's loss
stories.p: A supercomputer prediction model has made Arsenal favourites to win the Premier League after their latest win and Manchester City's defeat. The model simulates the rest of the season thousands of times.
more: Arsenal's win and City's slip changed the title odds.
Predictions of this kind can shift quickly from week to week.

stories.h: COCIN women's fellowship leader reportedly dies, Tinubu sends condolences
stories.p: The leader of the COCIN women's fellowship has reportedly died, and President Tinubu has reacted with a message of condolence. Further details on the circumstances were not immediately available.
more: Tributes are said to be coming in from church members.
Funeral arrangements have not yet been announced.

stories.h: Tinubu's full campaign flag-off speech published after APC's Kaduna launch
stories.p: The text of President Tinubu's remarks at the APC 2027 presidential campaign flag-off has been published. He used the Kaduna event to defend his record and appeal to voters ahead of the 2027 polls. Reaction from opposition parties has continued to follow.
more: The speech followed his remarks accusing opponents of exploiting hunger.
The ADC and NDC camps have already answered parts of it.
Port Harcourt is the next stop on the campaign timetable.

stories.h: EFCC recruitment 2026: open positions, requirements and how to apply
stories.p: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission has reportedly opened recruitment for new staff. A guide sets out the available roles, eligibility requirements and the application steps.
more: Applicants are advised to check eligibility before applying.
Details are said to be available on the commission's official portal.

stories.h: Prominent Islamic cleric reportedly dies in Zamfara State
stories.p: A prominent Islamic cleric has reportedly died in Zamfara State, according to Hausa-language reports. Further details on the cause and funeral arrangements are said to be awaited.
more: Tributes are said to be coming in from followers.
Details are still emerging.

stories.h: First Lady Remi Tinubu says she hopes to leave Aso Rock in 2031 to a Nigeria she can enjoy
stories.p: Remi Tinubu has spoken about when she expects to leave the presidential villa, saying she hopes to hand over in 2031 to a country that is more comfortable to live in. The remark has drawn wide comment as the 2027 campaign begins.
more: Her words are being read as a sign the family expects two terms in office.
Opposition figures have yet to respond directly.
Supporters say she was speaking about hopes for a better country.

stories.h: US agencies reportedly publish names and photos of Nigerians wanted over fraud and drug offences
stories.p: American law enforcement agencies have reportedly released the names and photographs of several Nigerian nationals they want in connection with alleged fraud and drug-related offences, and listed the accusations against them.
more: The notices are said to come from the FBI and the DEA.
Those named have not been tried and the allegations remain unproven.
Nigerian authorities have not yet commented.

stories.h: Adekunle Gold praised for giving N250,000 each to first-class graduates
stories.p: Adekunle Gold is drawing praise online after reportedly gifting N250,000 each to several first-class graduates. The singer is also in the news for a separate $20,000 initiative for sickle cell patients.
more: Many commenters called it a rare gesture of encouragement for academic excellence.
It follows his sickle cell announcement earlier today.
stories.alt: Adekunle Gold singing into a microphone

stories.h: Dele Momodu takes a swipe at Wike over those 'inconsolable' about missing out on candidacy
stories.p: Publisher Dele Momodu has reportedly said some people remain inconsolable because they did not get a party ticket, in a remark widely read as aimed at Nyesom Wike.
more: The comment adds to the exchange of words among political figures ahead of 2027.
Wike has not responded in the reports seen so far.

stories.h: 653 people reportedly convicted as federal government secures terrorism verdicts in Abuja mass trial
stories.p: The federal government has reportedly secured the conviction of 653 people in a mass terrorism trial held in Abuja.
more: The trial is among the largest of its kind in the country.
Details of the sentences were not immediately clear.

stories.h: Edo refinery reportedly exceeds full production capacity, with diesel supply at 620,000 litres a day
stories.p: The Edo refinery is said to be producing above its stated capacity, with daily diesel supply reportedly reaching 620,000 litres, as marketers adjust prices after Dangote halted diesel gantry sales.
more: The development comes as fuel marketers release new diesel prices.
Analysts will watch whether pump prices ease.

stories.h: APC youth leader and his wife reportedly kidnapped days after a lawmaker was killed
stories.p: An APC youth leader and his wife have reportedly been abducted, only days after a lawmaker was killed. Security agencies are said to be searching for them.
more: The incident has raised fresh worries about insecurity as the campaign season opens.
No group has claimed responsibility.

stories.h: Rivers government condemns alleged forced virginity testing of female secondary school students
stories.p: The Rivers State government has condemned reports that female secondary school students were subjected to forced virginity testing, calling the practice unacceptable.
more: Rights groups have long described such tests as degrading.
The state is expected to investigate the school concerned.

stories.h: Zimbabwean tycoon Wicknell Chivayo's custom Rolls-Royce Phantom arrives weeks after his death in a helicopter crash
stories.p: A custom Rolls-Royce Phantom ordered by Zimbabwean businessman Wicknell Chivayo has reportedly arrived at his Harare home, weeks after he died in a helicopter crash.
more: The car was ordered before his death.
Photos of its arrival have spread widely online.

stories.h: Six reportedly killed and 28 injured as gunmen open fire at a Greek Orthodox church in Jordan
stories.p: Gunmen have reportedly attacked a Greek Orthodox church in Jordan, killing six people and wounding 28, according to video and reports circulating online.
more: Security forces are said to have responded to the scene.
Authorities have not yet given a full account of the attack.

stories.h: Melania Trump reportedly helps secure a temporary Russia-Ukraine ceasefire so the elderly can be evacuated
stories.p: Melania Trump is reportedly credited with helping to arrange a short ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine to allow elderly civilians to be evacuated.
more: Details of how long the pause will last are unclear.
Neither government had given a detailed statement in the reports seen.

stories.h: Asian football chief backs Gianni Infantino for another term as FIFA president
stories.p: A leading Asian football official has publicly backed Gianni Infantino to serve another term as FIFA president.
more: Other confederations are yet to declare their positions.
The FIFA election is some way off.

stories.h: JPMorgan reportedly enters Nigeria and appoints a former CBN governor as a director
stories.p: Global bank JPMorgan has reportedly begun operations in Nigeria. The move is said to include the appointment of a former Central Bank of Nigeria governor to its local board. The development is being read by many as a sign of renewed foreign interest in the Nigerian financial market.
more: The appointment of a former central bank chief is drawing attention in banking circles.
Details of the licence and the scale of the planned operations were not immediately clear.

stories.h: Xabi Alonso explains what went wrong as Chelsea lose to Tottenham
stories.p: Chelsea were beaten by Tottenham in the London derby, and manager Xabi Alonso has spoken about where his side fell short. Fans online have been debating the result and the team's form. The defeat comes on a weekend when rivals picked up points.
more: Alonso pointed to key moments in the match that went against his team.
The loss has reignited talk about Chelsea's season so far.

stories.h: Andre Onana reportedly taken to hospital after a multi-car crash in Turkey
stories.p: Goalkeeper Andre Onana was reportedly taken to hospital after a multi-car collision in Turkey. No serious injury has been reported so far. Further updates on his condition are expected.
more: Reports say he was checked by doctors as a precaution.
His club has yet to give a detailed statement.

stories.h: Skit maker Gilmore claims Kai Cenat borrowed one of his ideas
stories.p: A Nigerian skit maker known as Gilmore has reportedly claimed that streaming star Kai Cenat used an idea he had created earlier. The claim has set off debate among online content creators about credit and originality. Kai Cenat has not been reported to have responded.
more: Some creators online say ideas often overlap, while others are urging credit for original makers.
The post has drawn comments from fans on both sides.

stories.h: Natasha Osawaru's video of Peter Obi sparks reactions ahead of 2027
stories.p: A video of social media personality Natasha Osawaru featuring Peter Obi is drawing reactions online as the 2027 race heats up. Supporters and critics have been trading comments about the clip. The NDC presidential candidate's camp has not been reported to have commented on it.
more: The clip is circulating widely on social media.
Obi's supporters have been sharing it as an endorsement of his campaign.

stories.h: Obasanjo's son names his preferred 2027 presidential candidate
stories.p: A son of former President Olusegun Obasanjo has reportedly named the candidate he would like to see win the 2027 presidential election. His comments have added to the debate about the opposition and ruling-party tickets. The family name carries weight in Nigerian politics, so the remarks are being widely discussed.
more: He spoke about what he wants to see from the next president.
Reactions online have been mixed.

stories.h: Sheikh Daurawa says he will not campaign for any candidate in 2027
stories.p: Prominent Kano cleric Sheikh Aminu Daurawa has said he will not campaign for any presidential candidate in 2027. He made the remark as parties step up their campaigns across the north. His position is being noted by political watchers in the region.
more: The cleric's statement was reported in Hausa-language coverage.
Parties are competing for influential voices in the north.

stories.h: CBN warns that keeping money received by mistake could mean 5 to 10 years in prison
stories.p: The Central Bank of Nigeria has warned that anyone who keeps money mistakenly paid into their account could face a prison sentence of five to ten years. The warning comes as more Nigerians use transfers and mobile banking. Customers are advised to report wrongly received funds to their banks.
more: The CBN urged customers to alert their banks promptly.
The reminder follows several public cases of wrong transfers.

stories.h: Philanthropist Okwuluora vows to personally fund woman's medical treatment, says no fundraising needed
stories.p: Popular philanthropist Okwuluora says he will take full responsibility for the medical treatment of a woman whose condition has drawn wide public attention, paying all costs from his own pocket until she recovers. He plans to send her photograph to doctors at Parklane Hospital and the University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital (UNTH) in Enugu for assessment, then bring her and her family in for treatment once they approve. He said he first stepped back because some people around her appeared more interested in the money that could be raised than in her wellbeing, but he has now decided to go ahead without any public fundraising. Once she has recovered, he said, an account could be opened for well-wishers who want to support her.
more: Okwuluora said concerns about her safety made him reconsider his involvement before he decided to proceed.
Her case has also sparked a debate online, with some Nigerians asking why pastors who claim to perform healing miracles have not stepped forward to help her.
Others are asking why cases like hers so often depend on expensive treatment and public donations.
stories.alt: A woman in a yellow and black print dress, her body visibly swollen, crosses a road beside a tricycle

stories.h: Peller says Jarvis's sister refused to greet him in his own house
stories.p: Streamer Peller has reportedly called out members of his wife Jarvis's family, saying her sister would not even greet him at home. The claim follows a livestream that ended after an argument over the sister. Jarvis has separately told critics to stop pushing her to respect him.
more: The row began during a livestream that ended abruptly on Friday.
Fans are split between the couple on social media.
Neither family has issued a fuller statement.

stories.h: Atiku reportedly accuses security agents of protecting Tinubu's banners in Kaduna
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly confronted the Tinubu camp over allegations that security agents guarded campaign banners in Kaduna ahead of the APC flag-off. The APC has in turn accused the ADC of a fake news plot around the rally. Neither side has produced evidence publicly.
more: The rally is the formal start of Tinubu's 2027 re-election campaign.
Both camps are trading accusations online.
Police have not commented on the banner claim.

stories.h: Kwankwaso says Tinubu does not deserve a second term
stories.p: Opposition figure Rabiu Kwankwaso has said President Tinubu has not earned a second term, criticising the administration's record on the economy and cost of living. The APC maintains its reforms are working and will be defended on the campaign trail.
more: Kwankwaso is a leading figure in the NDC alliance.
The APC points to its 90-day cost-of-living plan.
Campaign rhetoric is expected to sharpen after the Kaduna flag-off.

stories.h: Omo-Agege warns election riggers in 2027 will face serious consequences
stories.p: Former Deputy Senate President Ovie Omo-Agege, now seeking a Senate seat on the NDC platform, has reportedly warned that anyone who rigs the 2027 elections will face grave consequences. His wording has drawn comment online, with some reading it as a threat and others as a warning about public anger.
more: He is running under the NDC banner.
INEC has repeatedly promised credible polls.
Critics have asked him to clarify what he meant.

stories.h: Uganda restricts transit for travellers with recent DR Congo travel history
stories.p: Uganda has reportedly barred travellers with recent DR Congo travel history from transiting through its territory while an Ebola-related investigation continues. The move comes as Nigeria places 15 states on Ebola alert.
more: Nigeria has told hospitals to prepare isolation centres.
Health authorities are urging calm and basic hygiene.
More travel rules could follow across the region.

stories.h: Macron reportedly postpones his 28 October visit to Nigeria
stories.p: French President Emmanuel Macron has reportedly postponed a planned trip to Nigeria that was due on 28 October. No new date has been given in the reports seen so far, and neither government has detailed the reason.
more: The visit had been billed as a state-level engagement.
Officials have not announced a new date.
The Presidency has not commented publicly.

stories.h: Saka reportedly out for up to eight weeks with a thigh injury
stories.p: Arsenal winger Bukayo Saka is reportedly facing up to eight weeks on the sidelines with a thigh injury. The England and Arsenal forward is a heavy loss for the club during a busy run of fixtures.
more: Arsenal have not yet given a formal return date.
He is also a Nigerian-heritage fan favourite.
England fans are watching his fitness closely.

stories.h: Ronaldo scores his 982nd career goal in an Al Nassr win
stories.p: Cristiano Ronaldo has reportedly added another goal to his career tally, reaching 982 as Al Nassr won in the Saudi Pro League. The forward continues to chase the 1,000-goal milestone.
more: He is closing in on 1,000 career goals.
Al Nassr stay in the title race.
Fans are counting down the remaining goals.

stories.h: US reportedly charges two former FBI officials over statements about the Hunter Biden laptop
stories.p: Two former FBI officials have reportedly been charged in the United States over alleged false statements to Congress about the Hunter Biden laptop. Both are expected to contest the charges.
more: The case is likely to stay politically charged.
Court dates have not been widely reported.
Lawyers for the pair are expected to enter pleas.

stories.h: Eight Zamfara lawmakers reportedly return to the APC after meeting Tinubu
stories.p: Eight Zamfara Assembly members who quit the APC earlier this month are reported to have rejoined the party. Minister of State for Defence Bello Matawalle is said to have led them to the President, and a planned move to the ADC was reportedly shelved. The lawmakers had complained about unpaid salaries and insecurity.
more: Matawalle is being hailed by party supporters over the return.
Vehicles were reportedly presented to the lawmakers in Gusau on 21 October.
The ADC has not yet responded to the reported reversal.

stories.h: Wike makes fresh claim about Peter Obi, saying he gave him his political start
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly made a new claim about Peter Obi, saying he helped him in the past. Obi's camp has not yet responded to the remarks. The comments are drawing wide reaction as 2027 campaigning heats up.
more: Wike has previously said he gave Obi logistics support in 2023.
Supporters of Obi have disputed Wike's accounts before.

stories.h: Tinubu video taking aim at Atiku and Obi trends: 'You will not regret it'
stories.p: A video of President Tinubu urging voters to back him while taking aim at Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi is trending online. It comes from the build-up to his campaign flag-off in Kaduna. Opposition supporters and APC loyalists are trading comments under the clip.
more: Atiku earlier replied to Tinubu's hunger remarks, calling him delusional.
The clip has been shared widely on X and Facebook.

stories.h: Group called DMI backs Tinubu's economic reforms and announces 2027 alliance
stories.p: A group known as DMI has announced support for President Tinubu's economic reforms and declared an alliance ahead of the 2027 elections. The announcement adds to a run of endorsements as the APC campaign begins.
more: The group says the reforms need more time to deliver.
Critics say Nigerians are still struggling with the cost of living.

stories.h: Pastor Adeboye's blessing for his granddaughter on her wedding day stirs emotions
stories.p: RCCG General Overseer Pastor Enoch Adeboye has drawn warm reactions online over the blessing he gave his granddaughter on her wedding day. Videos from the ceremony are circulating widely, with many users sharing congratulatory messages to the family.
more: Guests included church leaders and family friends.
Clips of the prayer have been reposted thousands of times.

stories.h: Gunmen reportedly open fire on NDC candidate's convoy in Ebonyi
stories.p: Gunmen are said to have attacked the convoy of a candidate of the NDC in Ebonyi State, reportedly killing one person and injuring three others. Police are yet to give full details of the incident.
more: The candidate is not reported to have been among the injured.
The attack has raised fresh worries about election-season security.

stories.h: Sina Rambo's wife Heidi Korth responds to fresh reports of trouble in their marriage
stories.p: Heidi Korth has spoken out after new reports of a crisis in her marriage to Nollywood actor Sina Rambo. She has reportedly addressed the claims of separation online, and the actor is yet to publicly respond.
more: Fans have been split in the comment sections.
Neither side has announced any legal step.

stories.h: Video of Nigerian soldiers dipping bread in river water sparks outrage
stories.p: A video circulating online appears to show Nigerian soldiers in the field crouching at a muddy riverbank and dipping bread into the water before eating it. The footage has drawn an emotional response from Nigerians, many of whom say it shows the tough conditions troops face while fighting insecurity. The Nigerian Army has not commented on the video, and it is not yet clear when or where it was recorded.
more: Many users have contrasted the scene with the large sums being spent on campaigns ahead of the 2027 elections.
Others are calling for better welfare, rations and supplies for troops on the front line.
Trend Naija has not independently confirmed the details of the video.
stories.alt: Two Nigerian soldiers in camouflage crouch at a muddy riverbank, dipping pieces of bread into the brown water

stories.h: Unverified claims about Regina Daniels' family and close circle spread online
stories.p: Nollywood actress Regina Daniels is trending after a wave of unconfirmed claims about her family and people close to her spread on Instagram. Posts suggest her mother has raised concerns about some people in her daughter's circle, but the details being shared have not been backed up by any official source. Neither Regina nor her family has publicly responded, and Trend Naija has not been able to verify any of the reports.
more: There is no confirmation of any police involvement, despite claims being shared online.
None of the people mentioned in the posts has been shown to have done anything wrong.
Fans are urging caution, saying matters of family and health deserve privacy until the facts are clear.
stories.alt: Regina Daniels in a red head wrap smiles beside her mother, Rita Daniels, in a colourful print outfit

stories.h: Atiku fires back after Tinubu blames opponents for hunger
stories.p: At the APC campaign flag-off in Kaduna, President Tinubu reportedly asked who created hunger and poverty and answered that his rivals did. Atiku Abubakar has replied that blaming the opposition is either delusion or political amnesia, pointing out that the APC governed for eight years before Tinubu took office. He cited the naira's slide from about ₦471 to ₦1,329 to the dollar and World Bank poverty projections.
more: Atiku also questioned trillions of naira recorded under energy security spending.
The exchange sharpens the 2027 battle between the APC and the ADC.
Supporters on both sides are trading the clips online.

stories.h: Pat Utomi dares Tinubu to defend his record in a live debate
stories.p: Political economist Pat Utomi has reportedly challenged President Tinubu to defend his achievements in a live presidential debate. Utomi has previously urged INEC to make debates compulsory for candidates. Atiku has also said he would take part in 2027 debates only if Tinubu and the APC attend.
more: Tinubu's camp skipped broadcast debates in the 2023 cycle.
No response from the presidency had been reported at the time of writing.

stories.h: Calls grow in Britain to stop Macklemore's Wembley 'Free Palestine' show
stories.p: A group of British peers has reportedly asked the Home Secretary to block rapper Macklemore from entering the UK ahead of his concert at Wembley Arena on 30 October. The Jewish Leadership Council has also raised concerns with the promoter. Supporters say he is entitled to speak up for Palestinian rights.
more: He was dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour after on-stage comments last month.
Stars including Paloma Faith and Kehlani have backed him.

stories.h: Jarvis tells critics to stop pushing her to respect Peller
stories.p: Streamer Jarvis has hit back at people urging her to show more respect to her husband Peller, saying they should stop forcing it because the respect is not there. She added that women reflect whatever they are given in a relationship. The remarks have sparked fresh reactions online, about two months into their reported marriage.
more: "Whatever you show us is what we will reflect back," Jarvis said.
The comments follow the couple's recent public clashes, including a row over her younger sister.
Fans are divided, with many pointing out that respect in a marriage has to go both ways.
stories.alt: Peller and Jarvis pose side by side in matching white England football shirts

stories.h: Zlatan and Davita Lamai's traditional wedding gets underway
stories.p: Rapper Zlatan Ibile and Davita Lamai's traditional wedding is underway, with the singer releasing photos from the ceremony on Saturday. The pictures sent "Zlatan" and "Zanku" into Nigeria's top social media trends. Claims of a ₦2.3 billion wedding and a $1 million ring have not been backed up by any credible or official source.
more: The couple posed in matching red and white outfits with coral beads in the official photos.
Zlatan was earlier reported to have bought his bride a Hermes bag ahead of the wedding.
Big names from the entertainment industry are expected to celebrate with the couple.
stories.alt: Davita Lamai in a red beaded gown and coral crown stands beside Zlatan, seated on a gold throne in white and coral beads

stories.h: Remi Tinubu and Tompolo share a cheerful moment at an APC rally
stories.p: First Lady Senator Oluremi Tinubu and Government Ekpemupolo, popularly known as Tompolo, were seen laughing and exchanging warm smiles at an APC rally. Tompolo, a former Niger Delta militant leader, now holds a major federal pipeline security contract and has become an influential figure with ties to the ruling party. The relaxed moment has sparked conversation online about how political relationships evolve in Nigeria.
more: Tompolo wore a cap and vest bearing the name of a pro-Tinubu support group.
His firm's pipeline surveillance contract has been credited by the government with helping to curb oil theft in the Niger Delta.
The rally is part of the APC's 2027 re-election campaign.
stories.alt: Remi Tinubu in green APC attire smiles at Tompolo, seated beside her in a white cap and black vest

stories.h: Blessing CEO out of detention, Doris Ogala confirms
stories.p: Relationship coach Blessing CEO has been released from detention, actress Doris Ogala has confirmed. Ogala shared a video on social media showing her on a video call with Blessing shortly after her release.
more: Ogala appeared delighted in the clip as she spoke with Blessing.
Blessing CEO has not yet spoken publicly about her release.
stories.alt: Doris Ogala in a cap, sunglasses and striped top smiling during a video call in a car
